title: Neural network and kinetic modelling of human genome replication reveal replication origin locations and strengths.
summary: Model-derived origin locations/strengths agree with experimental replication profiles and support a two-step account in which licensing and firing jointly determine origin efficiency. Compared with experimental MRT/RFD and ORC/MCM profiles; computational inference against published replication data. Preprint v1 contains the result.
ai_technology: Neural-network inference combined with kinetic modeling estimates origin activation probabilities from genome-replication profiles.
organization: Laboratoire de Biologie et Modélisation de la Cellule, ENS de Lyon, Lyon, France

source_review.scope: The neural-network and kinetic replication model infers human replication-origin locations and strengths and reports that origin efficiency depends on both licensing and firing. Crossref links the article to bioRxiv preprint 10.1101/2021.12.15.472795; its v1 dated 2021-12-15 already contains the represented core result, so that is the first result-bearing version.
